about_the_game:
Ambrosia Sky OST combines found objects, scrap percussion, and evolving electronics to create a unique, hauntingly expressive soundscape — one that feels both alien and deeply connected to human nostalgia. Explore the world of the Cluster through these dynamically rich and immersive tracks by award-winning composer Grej. 

“This soundtrack has been a journey of just over two years, full of experiments and discoveries. I wanted to create something that felt unique to Ambrosia Sky— music that sits somewhere between composition and sound design. Along the way, I collected field recordings, built instruments from scrap percussion + metal, fused jaw harps to pipes, fed flutes through spring chambers, and even turned accordion bellows into a rhythmic instrument — all ways of shaping the palette to the resources of the Cluster, in an attempt to imagine not just what this future society might look like, but what it might sound like.” - Grej

CREDITS

Artist: Grej

Composer: Grej

Other Credits: Mixed & Edited by Grej, Mastered by Conor Dalton (Glowcast)

Audio Director: Michelle Hwu
